sources.title: API changelog
sources.claim: Oct 26 entry lists gpt-6.1-terra as released for v1/responses and v1/chat/completions; page supplies no time or timezone.

sources.title: GPT-6.1 Terra model documentation
sources.claim: Model id, 1,050,000 context, 128,000 max output; text/image input and text output; standard prices per 1M tokens: $1 input, $0.05 cached input, $1.25 30-minute cache write, $5 output. Longer-than-272K input pricing and other modes vary. Tool calls require Responses API.

sources.title: Gemini API release notes
sources.claim: For new paid-tier projects using Generate Content API, request logging/storage defaults to store=true; existing projects keep current setting. Opt out with store=false per request or disable logging in AI Studio settings.

sources.title: Data logging and sharing policy
sources.claim: Logs are private to the Google Cloud project and are for developer use; sharing with Google for feedback is an explicit choice. Options are location-dependent.

sources.title: Nemotron projects
sources.claim: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB project is dated Oct 23; explicitly older than the previous issue date, useful context only.

sources.title: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B model card
sources.claim: NVIDIA model card says model use governed by OpenMDW License Agreement 1.1, API by NVIDIA API Trial Terms; Apache 2.0 listed as additional information. Benchmark numbers are NVIDIA-evaluated, not independent replication.
